feedback: All test cases directly and adequately cover the requirement to accept nonnegative integer operands, including zero. Test R003-T01 validates addition with nonnegative integers, R003-T02 specifically checks zero as an operand in multiplication, and R003-T03 evaluates nested parentheses with nonnegative integers, ensuring proper precedence and grouping. The scope is complete within the stated constraints, and no invalid or unspecified cases are included. The justification for each test aligns with the customer intent and the declared interface. Mathematical reference checks are not needed as all expected results are simple and verifiable by standard arithmetic. Coverage is sufficient and focused on the core requirement.
